title: Kelly's street band lineup and favoured bass men
summary: Three cornets, clarinets, two drums, two trombones, baritone and bass; Kelly's favourite bass players.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Did he have more than one cornet in the marching band?
About how big a band did you have on the street?
Well, we have some... Tender drugs. Let's see. We have three cornet players. Clionettes. Two drums. Two trombones. A ballastone and a bass.
Remember who was, uh, Mike Vidi in those bands more than anyone?
I know you say a lot of different people, but the...
Oh, yeah. We speak of different fellas. We, uh...
Who were some of the main ones that Chris liked to use, so...
And, uh, George Hook across the river.
Carnet was he? No, he was, uh, Baratone.
Yeah. I forget that old man. He used to play with the Exaltion. Bass. ! Cris used to like them two fellas. He'd always get them.
What was his name, the bass player?
I can't get... I can't think of his name. It's been so long.
He used to play with, uh, Manuel Forrest. It's so.
Oh, uh, it would be Tats, uh, Alexander.

No, that's... he was, uh... Wouldn't be old Joe Howard. Ballastone. Wouldn't be old Joe Howard played. No, he was... He used to play bass. Sometime on the last... Yeah. On the last, he used to, uh, get Joe Howard, because Joe Howard was playing in, uh, bass in our, uh, orchestra. Orchestra. That's when we were out.
